mindefensa.name: HOMICIDIO (datos.gov.co m8fd-ahd9)
mindefensa.publisher: Ministerio de Defensa Nacional (data from Policía Nacional criminal statistics), on datos.gov.co
mindefensa.licence: Creative Commons Attribution | Share Alike 4.0 International (as stated on datos.gov.co)
mindefensa.notes: Source definition: 'Es toda muerte que fuere causada por otra persona por cualquier tipo de elemento (se mide en víctimas). Incluye: HOMICIDIO INTENCIONAL.' The source is record-level (one row per date/place/sex/weapon/modality with a CANTIDAD victim count); no municipal totals are published, so values here are SUMS of CANTIDAD by municipality, year and one breakdown at a time (Total, sex, weapon/means, presumed modality, urban/rural zone). No other transformation. SPOA characterisation 'FEMINICIDIO' kept as its own measure (separate from 'HOMICIDIO INTENCIONAL O CON DOLO'). Category labels kept in the source's Spanish.

medicina_legal.name: Presuntos Homicidios. Colombia, 2015 a 2024. Cifras definitivas (datos.gov.co vtub-3de2)
medicina_legal.publisher: Instituto Nacional de Medicina Legal y Ciencias Forenses (INMLCF), on datos.gov.co
medicina_legal.licence: Creative Commons Attribution | Share Alike 4.0 International (as stated on datos.gov.co)
medicina_legal.notes: Record-level forensic data (one row per victim). Values here are COUNTS OF RECORDS by municipality (DANE code of place of occurrence), year and one breakdown at a time: Total, sex, five-year age group, fatal-injury mechanism, detailed circumstance, presumed aggressor. The raw file has ~30 more attributes (ethnicity, scene, schooling, etc.) not tabulated here. Code 00999 'Sin información' = place unknown.

problems: geoBoundaries COL ADM2 has names only, no DANE codes; matched by name within department (department from placing each shape in an ADM1 shape), then 49 matched by hand to geoBoundaries' variant names (e.g. 'Distrito Especial, Industrial Y Portuario De Barr*' = Barranquilla, 'Tumaco' = San Andrés de Tumaco, Chocó names with seat in brackets, 'Santander (Araracuara)' = Puerto Santander, Amazonas). Each shape is used by one DANE code only. Values are aggregations (sums/counts) of the official record-level files, not tables the sources publish as such.
